pages.title: Very Evil
pages.text: The brown chalk is made with the essence of cruelty, and obtaining it certainly lives up$(br) to its name. Do the ends justify the means? Does morality truly exist? What is your morality?$(br)
This chalk is known to be part of an "Alignment Test." Anyone who possesses it is$(br) automatically classified as "Evil." What kind of spirits will these glyphs attract?$(br)
To obtain the $(item)Cruelty Essence$() for $(item)Brown Chalk$() you need to$(br) $(l:possession_rituals/possess_goat)summon and kill a Mercy Goat$(/l)$(br)
